'''''Asplenium auritum''''', the '''eared spleenwort''', is a species of fern native to the [[Neotropical Realm]] of the American Continent (from the [[Florida]] Peninsula to southern [[Brazil]] and northern [[Argentina]]) and Eastern [[Southern Africa]] (from [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|DR Congo]] to [[Madagascar]] and the [[Mascarene Islands]]).<ref>{{cite web |title=''Asplenium auritum'' Sw. |url=https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/HJVC |publisher=[[Catalogue of Life]] |access-date=14 February 2022}}</ref> Its presence is also recorded in the [[Azores]] where it might possibly be [[native species|native]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Rumsey |first1=Fred |last2=Schaefer |first2=Hanno |last3=Carine |first3=Mark A. |title=''Asplenium auritum'' Sw. sensu lato (Aspleniaceae: Pteridophyta)-an overlooked neotropical fern native to the Azores |journal=Fern Gazette |date=January 2014 |volume=19 |issue=7 |pages=259–271 |url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/289141643 |access-date=14 February 2022}}</ref>
